verdict.rationale: Attio offers a REST API with read/write access to deals and records, an official MCP server for AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to search/update the workspace, and AI features that claim to draft follow-ups, update records, and schedule next steps from call signals. However, there's no explicit documented capability for an agent to parse email/meeting signals and automatically update deal stages via API/MCP—this requires the user to build such a workflow themselves using the generic API/MCP primitives rather than a native, evidenced end-to-end feature.
